name: check-written-with-in
why: SQL Server stores a CHECK written with IN as a chain of ORs, so DacFx drops and re-creates the check on every plan (DECISIONS.md 2026-10-19).
action: Write the check in the OR form SQL Server stores; the difference stands until then.

name: clustered-key-rebuild
why: A clustered primary key moved to other columns makes DacFx rebuild the table, and the rebuild's tmp_ms_xx_ statements name objects the change did not.
action: Nothing: the statements are the change's own, since they name the table the change alters.

name: query-store-option
why: A model that declares no Query Store option plans OFF on DacFx 162.5.57 and READ_WRITE on 170.5.96 (DECISIONS.md 2026-10-19).
action: Run dbchange-lite on the DacFx release the toolchain ledger pins; doctor refuses another.

name: case-only-rename
why: Under a case-insensitive collation a rename that differs only by case plans as nothing, or as a drop and a create.
action: A person confirms whether the object was renamed or is drift.
